what: HARNESS.md says the few-shot examples are the first 3 of 6 pre-drawn candidates; the code drew cfg.EXP06A_FEWSHOT_CANDIDATES = 8
effect: every model used the first 3 of the 8 candidates (MMLU-Pro:69, 103, 118: all closed and correct; requests_record_<model>.json fewshot_items), so no model needed a 7th or 8th. A draw of 6 with the same seed is not guaranteed to give the same items (random.sample with a different k), so the examples could have differed under the documented draw; the examples actually used are fixed and recorded
